visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long black hair styled in two small buns and bangs sits at a white round table. She is wearing a white off-the-shoulder long-sleeved top. She addresses the camera while holding a smartphone. She stands up to display her pregnant belly, wearing grey shorts, in front of beige curtains and a white lamp. (2) The camera transitions to extreme close-ups of facial skin. Red acne spots are visible near the nose and cheek area. Another close-up shows dry, textured skin on the forehead. The lighting is bright and clinical to emphasize the imperfections. (3) The woman holds up two product containers from the SHEN brand: a tall golden spray bottle and a small white jar. She points to them with her fingers, smiling with her eyes slightly squinted, indicating approval and excitement. (4) A montage of product usage follows. She sprays the golden bottle towards her face. Close-up shots show a clear liquid droplet falling from a glass pipette onto her cheek. Her hands massage a white cream into her facial skin and then onto her forearms, showing a reflective, moisturized sheen. (5) The woman is seated again at the table, now with four SHEN brand products displayed in a row before her. She gestures broadly with both hands, pointing down at the items while speaking enthusiastically with a bright expression. Text overlays about ordering appear prominently.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice with a high-pitched, friendly, and animated tone speaks quickly in Traditional Chinese. Background music with an upbeat acoustic guitar and a light, steady drum beat starts immediately. The vocal delivery is energetic and clear with high arousal. (2) A male voice provides a short, calm response off-camera. The female speaker continues, her voice rising in pitch as she describes past skin issues. A sharp whoosh sound effect punctuates the transition to skin close-up descriptions, alongside a pop sound effect. (3) The female speaker introduces the skincare products with a professional yet enthusiastic tone. The BGM remains constant at a moderate tempo around 120 BPM. A ding notification-style sound effect is heard when product names are mentioned, creating a structured acoustic rhythm. (4) Acoustic artifacts like the subtle shhh of a spray nozzle and the faint clinking of glass bottles are audible under the continuous speech. The speaker maintains high speech density with minimal pauses, emphasizing the positive attributes of the items through vocal stress. (5) The final phase features the speaker's voice with increased volume and a rising intonation contour to deliver a call to action. The upbeat BGM continues at a steady level before abruptly cutting off as the video ends. A final ding sound effect marks the last graphic.
